review: I did not expect this album to be about me. It is about another people entirely — children taken, hair cut, a language beaten out. "The Tongue They Tried to Kill." My mother is in Port-au-Prince and she cannot talk to her own grandchildren and I am the one who let that happen. This album knows what that costs and it is not even about us. Five stars. God is good.
